title: A demo build maps each page of the business's current website to the demo page its old address should lead to, or says it is unmatched
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The old home page leads to the demo home (home); /restaurant/menu.html leads to /menu (same-slug); a title 'Gallery | Pho Ba' or a first heading 'Contact' leads to the demo page with that title (same-title); /our-menu and /contact-us lead to /menu and /contact (same-topic).
A page with no match is 'unmatched' with to null and redirect false: never the home page, never a template sample page (/typography) or an article.

Assets, tracking and display variants (sameAs names the plainest address kept), login/cart/search/feed addresses, tag/author/date listings, pagination, error pages, other hosts and invalid addresses are skipped, each with its reason.
The old title, meta description and first heading are carried over as read; a description research did not keep is null.

GET /api/website-opportunities/builds/:buildId/url-map reads the demo's pages through POST /api/sites/:key/apply {action: 'content.read', params: {view: 'pages'}} with the caller's cookie, keeps them on wo_build.built.pages, and answers the map; a failed read answers from the list kept before and never replaces it; with none kept the map is demo-not-read with the read's code.
Another account's build answers 404; a deleted demo 409 DEMO_DELETED; a build with no site 409 NO_DEMO; before the card's research finished the map is old-site-not-read.
The handover answer carries urlMap; a demo whose pages cannot be read still hands over, with urlMap.state demo-not-read.

GET /api/website-opportunities/:id/outreach carries urlMapProof '3 of your 4 current pages have a matching page on the demo, so their old addresses can lead there.' from the kept list only (no Apply call), without the total after a partial read, and null with no kept list.

tests: the old home page leads to the demo home; a page at the same address keeps it with no redirect
slug match: the last part of the address, whatever its parent, extension or trailing slash
title match: the old title with the site name taken out, or the first heading, equals a demo page title
topic match: the same kind of page by its words; the demo page with the shortest address wins
unmatched stays unmatched: no target, never the home page, never a template sample or an article
assets, system, archive, pagination, error pages, other hosts and duplicates are skipped, each with why
the old title, meta description and heading are carried over as read; none kept is null, never guessed
the outreach line counts matched pages, names the whole only after a complete read, never says 0
the map door reads the demo’s pages as the caller, keeps them, and maps each old page or says it is unmatched
a read of the demo that fails answers from the list kept before; with none kept, the map says it was not read
only the build’s own account, and only a demo that still has its site
the handover answers the map beside its steps, read again as the caller
the outreach line counts the old pages that have a match, from the list the build kept; none without one
